source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 249 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-249.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 249 was established by Ordinance No. 19283, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 10, 1986. Ordinance No. 19283 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 19283 was amended by Ordinance No. 19295, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 24, 1986. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19283; 19295; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-249.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 249 is established on property generally located at the west corner of Abrams Road and Walnut Street. The size of PD 249 is approximately 0.8034 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19283; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-249.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-249.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Utilization of the Property must comply with the city plan commission-approved development plan (Exhibit 249A). (Ord. Nos. 19283; 25711)

sections.title: Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-249.105. USES PERMITTED.

The only permitted uses on the Property are those uses permitted in an NO Neighborhood Office District and an electrical substation. (Ord. Nos. 19283; 25711)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-249.106. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must be provided as shown on the development plan. All required landscaping must be installed within six months of the issuance of a certificate of occupancy. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19283; 25711)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-249.107. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Off-street parking must be provided in accordance with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 19283; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-249.108. PAVING.

All parking, aisles, maneuvering areas, and driveway connections to streets or alleys, whether enclosed or unenclosed, must be surfaced to comply with the standards set out in the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 19283; 25711)

sections.title: Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-249.109. HEIGHT.

No structure may exceed 24 feet in height except as allowed in Section 51-4.408 (a)(1). (Ord. Nos. 19295; 25711)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-249.110. SETBACKS.

(a) Electrical substation. The minimum permitted setbacks for an electrical substation are as shown on the development plan.

(b) Neighborhood office. All neighborhood office uses must meet the standards set forth in the Dallas Development Code for an NO Neighborhood Office District. (Ord. Nos. 19283; 25711)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-249.111. SCREENING.

A nine-foot-high solid masonry screening wall must be maintained as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 19283; 25711)

sections.title: Maintenance
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-249.112. MAINTENANCE.

The entire premise must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19283; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-249.113. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the requirements for a non-business zoning district contained in the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 19283; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-249.114. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Utilization of the Property must comply with the requirements of all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19283; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-249.115. ZONING MAP.

PD 249 is located on Zoning Map No. D-9. (Ord. Nos. 19283; 25711)
